843114bb12f7c25e7e79.description: Jglow Esthetics is a Salinas-based beauty business owned by Jasmin, a licensed esthetician with 10 years of experience. Proudly serving Salinas and surrounding communities, Jasmin specializes in brow shaping, Brazilian waxing, full-body waxing, brow laminations, Korean lash lifts, and brow tinting. With a focus on personalized care, precision, and attention to detail, she strives to create a welcoming, professional, and comfortable environment where every client feels confident, valued, and beautiful.
